gather_points_by_index_with_padding: gather points from a tensor at given indices where -1 indicates padding and should be zeroed out
compute_weighted_mean_of_tensor: compute the weighted mean of a tensor across a specified dimension with an optional epsilon clamp
generate_batch_of_identity_matrices: generate a batch of N identity matrices of a given dimensionality on a specified device

compute_per_point_covariance_matrices: compute per-point covariance matrices from the K-nearest neighbors of each point in a point cloud
